system.name: NGCE (Node-Guided Contrastive Encoding)
system.one_liner: Multi-view graph clustering that encodes each view with node-feature-guided GNN filtering and cross-view contrast to get a consensus embedding for k-means.

content.variant_note: left panel unrolls the encoding module, right panels wire per-view copies into cross-view contrast, clustering and a weight feedback loop; symbol table below
content.argues: Node features guide the graph encoding of every view, and cross-view contrast plus pseudo-label homophily weights yield one consensus embedding that clusters well.
content.subject: One view's encoding module unrolled, then all views fused into a consensus embedding, clustered, and the homophily weight fed back.

summary: NGCE is a multi-view graph clustering method that uses node features to guide how each view's graph is encoded. Figure 1 combines three dashed panels and a symbol strip. At left, one Node-Guided Contrastive Encoding Module is unrolled from input (X, A^n, ω^n) to output h^n: a feature mapper f^n, a joint process building Â^n = ω^n A^n + S^n, two GNNs, a noise mask and two losses. At right, toy graphs for View 1 to View v each pass through that module, their embeddings are contrasted and fused with weights into H, which feeds k-means; the pseudo labels give the homophily weight ω^n that is fed back to the encoders. Dashed arrows mark backward propagation and a bottom table defines the symbols.
summary_zh: NGCE 是一种多视图图聚类方法，用节点特征引导各视图的图编码。图一左侧展开单个节点引导对比编码模块，右侧是跨视图对比与 k-means 聚类，伪标签算出的同质性权重回馈编码器，虚线箭头表示反向传播，底部符号表解释全部符号。
notes: Prior sample data graphs-molecules corrected to network-graph (toy graphs). The notation-key strip is counted as a legend, not a panel, so panel_count is 3. The roles of f^n and of the two GNNs are read from the figure and the key, not from the quoted text. The key spells Weight as Wight.
